why_Phi_alone_fails.consequence: Delta_Phi recovers the mixed forcing reservoir but cannot by itself reproduce the normalized wall, odd endpoint, and oriented tail columns required by T_PB

complete_pointed_bridge.one_leg_map: Delta_5(v) is the ordered direct sum of v tensor eta over the source-labelled anchors eta in M_5; equivalently v tensor id_(M_5) before applying rho_5

remaining_metric_gate.local: prove the source Green polarization on the four window matrix units and its equality with the completed analytic Green form after radical descent

conclusion: The fixed forcing vector Phi is one necessary anchor, not the whole bridge. The complete multiplicity-preserving Evans-to-pair candidate is the already existing five-cell Fourier module used as a pointed one-leg tensor factor. Its linear and C4 data, including wall and jump normalization, are fixed. The unresolved content is quadratic Green compatibility/relative cone positivity, not endpoint column construction.
